name: @naadi/shared
//sideEffects: Only zod-config runs code on import (z.config({ jitless: true })); every generated schema and SDK module imports it first itself (scripts/split-gen.mjs), so bundles drop the modules a chunk does not use (segment 22).
//: Type-checking uses the repo's TypeScript 7.0.2 (root devDependency). The local typescript 6.0.3 exists only as the peer of @hey-api/openapi-ts, which needs the JavaScript compiler API that TypeScript 7 (native) does not ship; 6.0.3 is the version openapi-ts itself is built and tested with.

scripts.gen: openapi-ts -f openapi-ts.config.ts && biome format --write src/gen && node scripts/split-gen.mjs && biome format --write src/gen && pnpm gen:ink
scripts.gen:ink: UPDATE_INK_SCHEMA=1 vitest run src/ink.test.ts && biome format --write ink.schema.json
